source.title: Code of Conduct Document Release and Competition Safety Policy Update (November 2020)
source.content:
The WCA has recently published the Code of Conduct and updated the Competition Safety Policy.

The new Code of Conduct can be found [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/Code%20of%20Conduct.pdf). This document acts as a standard of actions and behaviors of any member of the WCA, including Registered Speedcubers, Competitions Organizers, guests, WCA Officials, and users on the official WCA Forum. 

The safety policy has been updated to clarify that the holding of competitions within a region must be able to be done safely and includes a reminder that the Board has the right to cancel a competition if it is no longer safe to hold. The new version of the WCA Competition Safety Policy can be found [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Safety.pdf).

translation.title: 《行为准则》发布及《比赛安全政策》更新（2020 年 11 月）
translation.content:
WCA 近期发布了《行为准则》，并更新了《比赛安全政策》。

新的《行为准则》可在[这里](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/Code%20of%20Conduct.pdf)查看。这份文件为所有 WCA 成员的行为提供标准，包括已注册的速拧选手、比赛主办方、来宾、WCA 官员以及 WCA 官方论坛用户。

更新后的安全政策明确，各地区必须能够安全地举办比赛才可办赛；同时重申，如果比赛已不再具备安全举办的条件，董事会有权取消比赛。新版《WCA 比赛安全政策》可在[这里](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Safety.pdf)查看。
